description.value: Hicks Lake sits within Sasquatch Park's pocket-lake landscape north of Harrison Hot Springs, offering a sandy beach, warm-water swimming, and easy canoeing amid birch and second-growth forest; swimmer's itch is occasionally present in summer.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Hicks Lake Provincial Campground is an active frontcountry campground within Sasquatch Provincial Park, north of Harrison Hot Springs; a dedicated 'Hicks Lake Campground map [PDF]' is listed on the park page, corroborating the OSM record. Frontcountry camping reservations are explicitly described as available via camping.bcparks.ca, confirming that amenity. No specific amenity details (showers, potable water, hiker/biker sites, etc.) appear in the fetched pages, so those fields remain null per evidence-only rules.
